name: singularity-event-horizon
description: Singularity Flow's host for Event Horizon — thin integration layer over the upstream tool.

scripts.build: sh -c 'if [ -d ../../vendor/event-horizon/src ]; then electron-vite build && npm run build:contract; else echo "[event-horizon] upstream not connected — skipping build"; fi'
scripts.typecheck: sh -c 'if [ -d ../../vendor/event-horizon/src ]; then tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.node.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.web.json; else echo "[event-horizon] upstream not connected — skipping typecheck"; fi'
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run build
